config.description: Verifies Unix DogStatsD capture and replay through a Unix datagram socket
config.name: dogstatsd-replay-unix

sender:
import socket
import time

socket_path = "/tmp/saluki-dogstatsd-replay-unix.sock"
client = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
try:
    client.connect(socket_path)
    client.send(b"integration.replay.unix.one:1|c")
    time.sleep(1)
    client.send(b"integration.replay.unix.two:1|c")
finally:
    client.close()
